source_title: Dragon Ball: 7 Character Fusions That Completely Changed the Series
source_excerpt:
Over the years, the Dragon Ball franchise has introduced some of the greatest and most beloved concepts to the anime industry that have ever been seen. From transformations to reality-bending Martial Arts techniques, the impact that this franchise has had on anime and fiction as a whole simply can't be understated.
One of the best of these aspects that isn't really followed by many other franchises is the idea of fusion . By taking the strength of two warriors and adding them together, the resulting amalgamation exists as a singularly powerful being who is able to utilize the strength and techniques of both of their constituents. And so, let's break down the most important fusions in Dragon Ball .
7 Kibito Kai Is A Fusion Most Often Forget About
The Potara Earrings fusion method was introduced as the one used most by the Kai, in whose case the fusion is typically permanent. This was seen through the formation of Kibito Kai, when Shin and his attendant, Kibito, each put on a Potara Earring to eventually merge into a relatively powerful Kai.
In terms of overall strength, Kibito Kai made a note of how much stronger he felt, even offering to help in the battle against Buu. However, the power gap between him and the villain was still far too great. Ultimately, the formation of Kibito Kai was a huge turning point for the series, since the fusion was seen as the first instance of showing what the Potara Earrings were capable of.
6 Kefla Showed The Power Of Universe 6
The Tournament of Power was an event filled to the brim with incredibly exciting moments and standout highlights. As such, one of the greatest moments in the entire battle royale was the birth of Kefla, who was a Potara Earring fusion born from the merger of Caulifla and Kale, both of whom were incredibly powerful and talented Saiyan warriors.
Ultimately, for the greater scope of the Dragon Ball franchise, Kefla's impact was almost exclusively tied to the tournament itself. Still, though, she proved herself to be one of the strongest figures in the Tournament of Power and, thusly, one of the biggest obstacles that Universe 7 had to overcome to win, making her an incredibly important fusion overall.
5 Gotenks Was The Fusion Of Saiyan Prodigies
The Buu Saga was the one that showed the greatest escalation in power scaling in all of Dragon Ball Z as it was filled to the brim with exceptional battles and amazing new transformations. Among these was the birth of Gotenks , who was the combined state of Trunks and Goten through the Metamoran Fusion Dance and one of the highlights of the arc.
Through Gotenks, both young Saiyan prodigies had a very clear path to the highest levels of power which was quite different from that of the others, in that they chose to rise in power as a fused unit more than individually. As such, Gotenks' strength and talent was always clear to see, especially considering how he became the second-ever character to unlock Super Saiyan 3.
4 Merged Zamasu Was One Of The Greatest Villains
Over the course of the franchise, fusion has been used sparingly, and even moreso among villains, which is why Merged Zamasu goes down as one of the series' most powerful and terrifying villains. Born through the fusion of two different versions of the same character, this foe was able to take Super Saiyan Blue Vegito to his absolute limits in a very evenly matched fight.
In terms of impact throughout the story, one could argue that Zamasu's was among the greatest. Not only did he destroy Future Trunks' entire world, but upon having his body broken by the young Saiyan, his essence leaked out into the universe itself, infecting the entire timeline in a form that none other than Zeno himself could destroy.
3 Piccolo Became The Nameless Namekian Once More
In the modern era of Dragon Ball , Piccolo has become one of the strongest and most beloved characters in the entire series, and his recent Orange Piccolo form has once again brought him to the forefront as one of the series' main characters. However, many tend to forget that the Piccolo that we know of today is actually the product of a unique kind of Namekian fusion.
Essentially, this fusion is a permanent biological one, where one Namekian completely inherits the memories, personality, powers and abilities of another. Piccolo originally did this with Nail during the Namek Saga and then with Kami during the Cell Saga. In doing so, he once again awoke the power of the Nameless Namekian and laid the groundworks for the powerhouse he is now.
2 Gogeta's Power May Be Higher Than The Destroyers
Super Saiyan Blue Gogeta from Dragon Ball
Although he started off his journey as a non-canon character, Gogeta was always considered to be one of the strongest characters in the entire Dragon Ball franchise. Eventually, in the 2018 Broly film, he became a canon character whose strength was astronomical, especially considering that he could now use God Ki in order to awaken the Super Saiyan Blue state.
As the product of the Metamoran Fusion Dance performed by the two main characters of the franchise, Gogeta's importance to the overall world simply can't be understated. When he was reintroduced in Super , the entire power dynamic and scaling of the series changed, as many considered him to be one of the only mortals in the multiverse whose strength may exceed the Destroyers.
In terms of strength, Vegito and Gogeta are dead equals owing to the unique properties of their fusion techniques, as well as the fact that they are born of the same two Saiyans. However, in terms of overall impact on the story, there is no fusion in all of Dragon Ball that even remotely comes close to Vegito due to what his introduction means to it.
When Vegito was first summoned against Ultimate Buu, the entire power ceiling of the franchise shot up greatly, as this Saiyan took the power of the two strongest mortals in the universe at the time and bolstered it even further. In one way or another, every subsequent fusion in the franchise has taken something or another from Vegito, making him the greatest fusion in the series and the one who has changed the future of Dragn Ball for the better.
